title: 第一百五十五章 都被大壮吃豆腐，就是生气不了！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

孙菲菲的身体暴露光线之下，皮肤白皙细腻，锁骨精致如画，胸前的饱满在白色内衣的包裹下呈现出柔和的弧度。

腰肢纤细，小腹平坦，胯骨的线条在白色内裤的边缘若隐若现。

王大壮的目光从她的脸慢慢往下移，丹田中的灵气在体内飞速运转了好几个周天，硬生生把那股邪火压了下去。

随后闭上眼，展开灵目术。

灵气化作无数根比头发丝还细的丝线，探入她的大脑深处。

云状细胞瘤的情况比他预期的还要好，那些黑雾般的癌细胞被清神丹的药力压缩到大脑左半球颞叶后部那个非常边缘的区域。

比昨天又缩小了一圈，牢笼的墙壁也比昨天更厚了。

清神丹的药力把那些癌细胞像牧羊人驱赶羊群一样赶到了那个牢笼里，然后又在牢笼外面加了一层封印。

癌细胞在里面横冲直撞，可牢笼的墙壁一天比一天厚，它们每一次冲击的力度都比上一次弱。

抑郁症的情况也比昨天稳定。

脑部神经递质的水平正在恢复，羟色胺、多巴胺、去甲肾上腺素，这些调控情绪的关键物质正在一点一点地回归正常水平。

可王大壮也注意到一个问题。

清神丹的药力对癌细胞有奇效，可对她的身体造成的冲击也很大。

肝肾功能指标在下降，主要还是由于她太虚弱了。

王大壮没再继续观察，而是睁开眼睛，心里有了眉目之后从针包里抽出一根银针。

第一个穴位是百会穴，在头顶正中，是诸阳之会，主要调节精神意识的重要穴位。

银针刺入的瞬间，灵气顺着针尖渡入她的大脑，把清神丹的药力引导到最需要的位置。

神庭穴、本神穴、太阳穴……银针一根一根地从他的指间飞出去，精准地刺入预定的穴位。

随着时间推移，一个时辰过去了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Sun Feifei's body is exposed to the light, her skin is fair and delicate, her collarbones are delicate and picturesque, and her plump chest shows a soft arc under the white underwear.

The waist is slender, the lower abdomen is flat, and the lines of the hip bones are faintly visible on the edge of the white underwear.

Wang Dazhuang's eyes slowly moved down from her face. The spiritual energy in her Dantian circulated rapidly in her body for several days, suppressing the evil fire.

Then he closed his eyes and activated his spiritual eye technique.

The spiritual energy turned into countless threads thinner than hair and penetrated into the depths of her brain.

The situation of cloud cell tumors was better than he expected. Those black mist-like cancer cells were compressed by the power of Qingshen Pill to the very marginal area at the back of the temporal lobe of the left hemisphere of the brain.

It's smaller than yesterday, and the walls of the cage are thicker than yesterday.

The power of the Qingshen Pill drove the cancer cells into the cage like a shepherd driving her sheep, and then added a layer of seal outside the cage.

Cancer cells are rampaging inside, but the walls of the cage are getting thicker day by day, and each impact they make is weaker than the last.

The depression situation is also more stable than yesterday.

The levels of neurotransmitters in the brain are recovering, and serotonin, dopamine, and norepinephrine, the key substances that regulate emotions, are returning to normal levels little by little.

But Wang Dazhuang also noticed a problem.

The power of the Qingshen Pill had a miraculous effect on cancer cells, but it also had a huge impact on her body.

Her liver and kidney function indicators were declining, mainly because she was too weak.

Wang Dazhuang did not continue to observe, but opened his eyes, and after having an idea in his mind, he took out a silver needle from the needle bag.

The first acupuncture point is Baihui point, which is located in the middle of the head. It is the meeting point of the Yangs and is an important acupuncture point that mainly regulates spiritual consciousness.

The moment the silver needle penetrated, the spiritual energy flowed into her brain along the tip of the needle, guiding the power of the Qingshen Pill to the location where it was most needed.

Shenting acupoint, Benshen acupoint, temple... the silver needles flew out from his fingers one by one and penetrated the predetermined acupoints accurately.

As time passed, an hour passed.
